hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case "$f" in *.md) npx --yes markdownlint-cli2 "$f" 1>&2 || exit 2 ;; *.c|*.h) if command -v clang-format >/dev/null 2>&1; then clang-format --dry-run --Werror "$f" 1>&2 || exit 2; fi; ROOT=$(git -C "$(dirname "$f")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); CHECKPATCH="${ZEPHYR_BASE:-$ROOT/../zephyr}/scripts/checkpatch.pl"; if [ -f "$CHECKPATCH" ]; then ( cd "$ROOT" && perl "$CHECKPATCH" --no-tree -f "$f" ) 1>&2 || exit 2; fi ;; esac
